_about: scripts/gate.sh's thresholds for GTA V's prologue walk (walk-prologue.txt) on the Mac, D-149. Values from walk g of run 088 and the first gated runs, with margins: runs are not frame-exact, and the Mac's GPU time per frame flips between about 8.5 and 22-25 ms from run to run (run 088's walks a-g), so GPU ms is a loose ceiling and render passes per frame the structural check. Lower a limit when a change makes things better, never raise it to let one through.
